enemies.name: The Trickster
enemies.signature: Dazzle: 20 Light, apply pending Nausea and mark two Memory Holes (four below 60 HP). Anti-elemental: 20 counter damage, apply Holes and warn of H. H: 7 Chaos then 7 Light, shift a row right two and mark two Hypnoses. False face: 20 Chaos, apply Hypnosis and warn of V. V: 7 Light then 7 Chaos, shift a column down two and mark two Nauseas. Whole stacks wrap; Holes destroy arriving stacks and Hypnosis compels immediately. Corruptions can fill the entire grid. Each completed cycle adds 2 to single attacks and 1 to each split hit; Restless adds 1 per level to each hit. Anti-elemental counters the unique largest elemental Guard total, including equipment; ties use Arcane. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Read the committed line and landing spaces. Balance elemental Guard before Anti-elemental; its live Tell updates. Ordinary once-per-turn activation does not protect a card forcibly moved onto Hypnosis.
